author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Diamonds with engineered nitrogen vacancies are now used to create stable quantum bits, enabling room-temperature quantum computing with up to 128 qubits. This breakthrough by Saxon Q could revolutionize real-time processing in autonomous systems and robotics by making quantum computers more accessible and efficient.
